name: Checkstand lane bank — the only zone this guide needs bridged: the register lanes are 6-9 pt (~0.6-0.8 m) gaps between checkstand fixtures. Rect is the lane band ONLY: the checkstand fixtures are drawn y=599.7-631.6, so the zone stops at y=632. It must not reach further south — y 632-710 is the front lobby (Business Center counter, the lease bays, the Ice machines, the Exit doors), and the walkway that links them to the U-Scan gap runs along the back of the checkstands at just 13.4 pt (~1.2 m), narrower than this zone's own 14 pt bridge. The earlier y1=678 closed that walkway and sealed the whole Business Center bay off from the store (and, being a rect seal zone, exempted itself from the sealed-floor-paint net, so nothing flagged it). The front action alley north of the bank stays open. NOTE the derived zones are dropped on purpose: this guide is drawn at 0.088 m/pt (vs 0.118 at store 659), so its shopping aisles are only ~12.9 pt (~1.1 m) wide and the auto 130 pt / 12 pt service disks bridge real aisles shut (Toys/Seasonal, Kitchen housewares, Card & Party). The four counters that genuinely need sealing (deli/bakery block, seafood, pharmacy) are drawn as walled rooms and are handled verbatim in exclusions.json instead; KITCHEN here is a housewares department and FLORAL an open display island, neither has a counter to seal
